text_en: The beast that both you and that other boy describe...
It seems to be a Feral, a creature whose energy rivals that of the Valkyries...
My suspicions proved correct. If that creature has been here, it can't have been for a good reason.
It's important you tell me exactly where you faced him. I must see it with my own eyes.
No... Do not worry, I shall take care of it. If he really has revealed the location of the Guardian to you, you'd best take his word as truth.
Lying doesn't come naturally to those beasts.
